description_en: Updates an RTC cloud recording task
name: UpdateRtcCloudRecording

parameters.description_en: The task ID. This ID is returned by StartRtcCloudRecording. Only tasks in the running or abnormal state can be updated.
parameters.description_zh: 任务id。由 StartRtcCloudRecording 返回，只支持更新运行中或异常中的任务。

fields.description_en:
The list of subscribed UserId entries. In single-stream recording mode, each UserId is recorded separately. In stream mixing recording mode, the audio and video of all UserIds are mixed into a single set of audio and video.
> 
> - The array supports a maximum of 17 elements.
fields.description_zh:
订阅的UserId信息列表，单流录制模式下，会对其中每个UserId分别进行录制；混流录制模式下，会将所有UserId的音视频混合到一组音视频中。
> 
> - 数组内最多支持17个元素。

parameters.description_en: The updated layout parameters. Leave this parameter empty in single-stream recording mode. This parameter is required in stream mixing recording mode when the transcoding output is not audio-only.
parameters.description_zh: 更新后的布局相关参数，单流录制模式下不填，混流录制模式下非纯音频转码时必填。

fields.description_en: The window layout information of the subscribed users. Only UserIds with layout information configured are placed in the output. This parameter is required in stream mixing mode when recording non-audio-only files.
